About Google

Google is a place where brilliant people do their best work together. From solving hard problems to building scalable infrastructure that serves billions of users, our engineers work on some of the most challenging and impactful technical problems in the world.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Core Infrastructure team. You will design, build, and maintain systems that handle petabyte-scale data and serve hundreds of millions of requests per day. This is a high-impact role where your work will directly affect products used by billions of people worldwide.

Responsibilities

• Design and implement large-scale distributed systems from scratch and maintain existing ones
• Own end-to-end delivery of critical infrastructure components, from architecture to production deployment
• Mentor junior engineers and set technical direction for your team
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, data scientists, and SREs
• Drive technical design reviews and contribute to architectural decisions
• Champion engineering best practices: code reviews, documentation, testing, and on-call processes
• Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks; optimize for latency, throughput, and reliability

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of software engineering experience
• Proficiency in one or more of: Go, Java, C++, Python
• Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts: consistency, availability, partition tolerance
• Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design
• Experience building and operating production systems at scale
• Track record of owning complex technical projects end to end

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform or similar cloud infrastructure
• Familiarity with Kubernetes, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers
• Experience with large-scale storage systems (Bigtable, Spanner, or equivalents)
• Prior experience in tech companies handling >1B requests/day
• Publications or open-source contributions in distributed systems or databases

What We Offer

Competitive compensation including base salary, equity (RSUs), and comprehensive benefits. Opportunity to work on systems that define the state of the art in the industry. A culture that values intellectual humility, deep technical thinking, and respect for all people.

About Meta

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram, and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our News Feed team. You'll work on one of the most highly trafficked and technically complex frontends in the world — a system that serves 3 billion people daily with personalized content. You'll own performance-critical features, drive architecture decisions, and mentor engineers across the team.

Responsibilities

• Build and maintain highly performant, accessible React applications used by billions of users
• Lead the design and implementation of complex UI systems and component libraries
• Drive large-scale frontend migrations and architectural improvements
• Partner with product, design, and data science to ship experiments that move key metrics
• Champion accessibility, performance, and code quality across the team
• Conduct rigorous A/B tests and use data to make product decisions
• Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering culture through code reviews and tech talks

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of frontend engineering experience
• Expert-level proficiency in React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
• Deep understanding of browser performance, rendering, and web APIs
• Experience with GraphQL or similar data-fetching paradigms
• Track record of shipping large-scale, production frontend features
• Strong communication skills and ability to influence technical direction

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Meta's technology stack (Relay, React Native, Hack)
• Experience optimizing Web Vitals and Core Web Performance metrics
• Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards
• Prior experience at a consumer product company with millions of daily active users
• Experience with server-side rendering, code splitting, and bundle optimization

What We Offer

Market-leading compensation, equity upside in a multi-billion-dollar company, 401k matching, generous parental leave, and the opportunity to work on products that shape how billions of people experience the internet.

About Flipkart

Flipkart is India's leading e-commerce marketplace with over 500 million registered customers and more than 1.5 million sellers. Our technology team solves India-scale problems — managing massive traffic spikes during Big Billion Days, building real-time inventory systems, and creating personalized experiences for a diverse country with unique connectivity challenges.

About the Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our Checkout & Payments team. This team owns one of the most critical flows in e-commerce — you'll work on systems that process millions of transactions daily, ensuring they're fast, reliable, and fraud-resistant. You'll work across the full stack, from React-based checkout UIs to distributed Java backend services.

Responsibilities

• Design and build full-stack features across React frontends and Java Spring Boot microservices
• Own the checkout flow performance — reduce drop-offs, improve conversion, ensure sub-second load times
• Build and maintain real-time fraud detection integrations and payment gateway abstractions
• Collaborate with product and design to run A/B experiments on checkout UX improvements
• Participate in on-call rotations and own the reliability of your systems
• Write comprehensive tests (unit, integration, load) and maintain high code coverage
• Contribute to architectural decisions for scalability and maintainability

Minimum Qualifications

• 3+ years of software engineering experience
• Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot for backend development
• Proficiency in React for building responsive, performant user interfaces
• Experience with relational databases (MySQL) and caching (Redis)
• Understanding of microservices architecture and message queues (Kafka)
• Experience with containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience scaling systems to handle 10x traffic spikes
• Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)
• Experience with payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Paytm)
• Knowledge of fraud detection patterns and security best practices
• Experience with Elasticsearch for search and analytics

What We Offer

Competitive compensation, ESOP grants, health insurance, flexible working hours, and the chance to work on technology that serves 500 million Indians.

About Razorpay

Razorpay is India's leading full-stack financial solutions company. We power payments and banking infrastructure for over 8 million businesses, from early-stage startups to India's largest enterprises. We process over $90 billion annually, making us the backbone of India's digital economy.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer for our Core Payments Platform team. You'll build and scale the systems that sit at the heart of Razorpay — the payment orchestration layer that intelligently routes transactions, handles retries, manages bank integrations, and ensures every rupee reaches where it should. This is a role for engineers who love working at the intersection of distributed systems and financial reliability.

Responsibilities

• Design and implement high-throughput, low-latency payment processing systems
• Build robust integrations with banks, card networks, and UPI providers
• Implement retry logic, fallback routing, and intelligent payment orchestration
• Ensure PCI-DSS compliance across all payment data handling
• Own system observability: metrics, alerts, runbooks, and post-mortems
• Drive the design of APIs used by 8 million businesses
• Mentor junior engineers and shape the team's engineering culture

Minimum Qualifications

• 4+ years of backend engineering experience
• Proficiency in Python or Go for high-performance backend systems
• Deep experience with PostgreSQL and database optimization
• Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and Kafka
• Experience building and securing financial or payment systems
• Track record of improving system reliability (SLA >99.99%)

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with PCI-DSS compliance and security audits
• Familiarity with UPI, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS payment rails
• Experience with rate limiting, circuit breakers, and bulkhead patterns
• Knowledge of cryptography and secure key management
• Prior fintech or banking technology experience

What We Offer

Equity package in a Series F company, competitive salary, comprehensive health coverage, opportunities to shape India's financial infrastructure at scale.

About Amazon

Amazon is guided by four principles: customer obsession rather than competitor focus, passion for invention, commitment to operational excellence, and long-term thinking. We are driven by the excitement of building technologies that change how hundreds of millions of customers shop, engage with Amazon devices, and experience the world.

About the Role

SDE II role on the Amazon Fulfillment Technology team. You'll build the systems that coordinate the movement of billions of packages across Amazon's global fulfillment network. Your work will directly affect delivery speed, inventory accuracy, and the reliability of Amazon's promise to customers.

Responsibilities

• Design and develop highly available, low-latency services handling millions of requests/minute
• Own services from design through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement
• Decompose complex business problems into clean technical designs and service boundaries
• Write high-quality code with comprehensive test coverage and documentation
• Drive operational excellence: define SLAs, build dashboards, own on-call
• Participate in design reviews and contribute to architectural decisions
• Work backward from customer needs to define technical requirements

Minimum Qualifications

• 3+ years of professional software development experience
• 2+ years of non-internship design experience
• Proficiency in Java (or C++/Python) and object-oriented design
• Experience with distributed system design and AWS services
• Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software design
• Experience with unit testing and code review practices

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with AWS DynamoDB, S3, SQS, Lambda, and CloudFormation
• Prior experience at large-scale e-commerce or logistics companies
• Familiarity with event-driven architectures and stream processing (Kinesis)
• Experience with NoSQL databases and their trade-offs vs relational
• Background in inventory management or supply chain systems

Our Leadership Principles

Amazon's 16 Leadership Principles guide every hire, promotion, and decision. In your interview, you'll be evaluated heavily on: Customer Obsession, Ownership, Invent and Simplify, and Dive Deep. Come prepared with specific, detailed examples.

What We Offer

Base salary, sign-on bonus, RSU grants, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to work on systems at a scale matched by very few companies in the world.

About Swiggy

Swiggy is India's leading on-demand delivery platform. We deliver food, groceries, and more to millions of customers across 500+ cities in India. Our ML team is at the heart of how Swiggy personalizes recommendations, predicts delivery times, optimizes restaurant rankings, and fights fraud — all in real time.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior ML Engineer for our Personalization team. You'll build the ML systems that decide what a customer sees when they open Swiggy — restaurant rankings, dish recommendations, banners, and promotions. This is a high-impact role: even small improvements in our recommendation models directly translate to millions of additional orders.

Responsibilities

• Build end-to-end ML pipelines: data processing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment
• Design and ship personalization models for restaurant ranking, food recommendations, and search
• Own A/B testing framework for ML experiments — define success metrics, run experiments, analyze results
• Build and maintain MLOps infrastructure for model versioning, monitoring, and retraining
• Collaborate with data engineers to build high-quality feature stores
• Work with product managers to translate business goals into ML problem formulations
• Mentor junior ML engineers on best practices

Minimum Qualifications

• 3+ years of ML engineering experience
• Strong Python and ML framework proficiency (PyTorch or TensorFlow)
• Experience building and deploying recommendation systems or ranking models at scale
• Proficiency in feature engineering and working with large-scale datasets (Spark/SQL)
• Understanding of model evaluation, offline metrics, and online A/B testing
• Familiarity with MLOps: model serving, monitoring, and drift detection

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with real-time ML inference and feature serving
• Familiarity with LLMs and their integration into search/recommendation systems
• Experience with reinforcement learning for recommendation/ranking
• Prior experience at a high-scale consumer Internet company
• Knowledge of Airflow, dbt, or similar pipeline orchestration tools

What We Offer

Competitive salary, ESOPs, health and wellness benefits, flexible work arrangements, and the chance to build ML systems that touch the daily lives of 100 million Indians.

About Groww

Groww is India's largest investment platform with over 10 million active investors. We've built an infrastructure that handles real-time trading across stocks, mutual funds, F&O, and US stocks — all with the reliability that financial systems demand. Our Platform team is responsible for the infrastructure that never goes down.

About the Role

Senior SRE / Platform Engineer on the Infrastructure team. You'll own the reliability of Groww's platform during high-volatility market moments when 100,000 concurrent users are placing trades. When markets open at 9:15 AM, our systems must be perfect — and you'll be the one ensuring that.

Responsibilities

• Own and evolve Groww's Kubernetes-based infrastructure across multiple AWS regions
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitOps with ArgoCD) that enable 50+ deployments per day
• Design and implement infrastructure-as-code with Terraform for reproducible environments
• Build comprehensive observability (Prometheus, Grafana, distributed tracing) with proactive alerting
• Lead chaos engineering initiatives to proactively identify and fix reliability gaps
• Respond to production incidents, conduct blameless post-mortems, and implement preventive fixes
• Drive security hardening: secrets management, network policies, RBAC, vulnerability scanning

Minimum Qualifications

• 4+ years of DevOps/SRE experience
• Expert-level Kubernetes knowledge: scheduling, networking, storage, security
• Strong Terraform and AWS infrastructure experience
• Experience with CI/CD systems (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD)
• Proficiency in Python or Go for automation and tooling
• Experience building observability stacks and on-call processes

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in financial services or other high-reliability domains
• Familiarity with service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and eBPF-based observability
• Experience with chaos engineering tools (Chaos Monkey, LitmusChaos)
• HashiCorp Vault for secrets management
• CKA/CKAD/CKS certifications

What We Offer

ESOPs, competitive salary, best-in-class health insurance, learning budget, and the satisfaction of building infrastructure that enables financial freedom for millions of Indians.

About Microsoft

Microsoft is a technology company that believes in empowering every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Our products — from Windows and Office to Azure and Teams — are used by billions of people worldwide. We hire people who are curious, collaborative, and passionate about making a real difference.

About the Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer (Frontend) to join Microsoft Teams, the fastest-growing productivity app in Microsoft history with 300 million monthly active users. You'll work on the Teams client experience — building features that millions of people use for work every day.

Responsibilities

• Build accessible, high-quality React + TypeScript features for Microsoft Teams
• Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to ship end-to-end features
• Write unit, integration, and accessibility tests for your code
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to the team's engineering standards
• Monitor your features in production and respond to customer feedback
• Learn and grow through mentorship from senior engineers

Minimum Qualifications

• 1+ years of software engineering experience (or equivalent internship/project experience)
• Proficiency in TypeScript and React
• Understanding of web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, browser APIs
• Experience consuming REST APIs
• Basic understanding of accessibility principles (ARIA, keyboard navigation)
• Strong communication and collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Microsoft's Fluent UI design system
• Familiarity with Azure or other cloud platforms
• Contributions to open-source projects
• Experience with automated testing and CI/CD
• Knowledge of i18n/l10n for global products

What We Offer

Industry-leading compensation, comprehensive benefits, flexible work arrangement (hybrid), parental leave, tuition reimbursement, employee stock purchase plan, and a culture that invests in your long-term growth.
